tool_calls.arguments:
{"content":"apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-client-access
  namespace: app-ns
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: my-application
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: client-ns # Placeholder for client namespace identification
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8080 # Placeholder for application port
  # Other restrictive rules might exist here, ensuring others remain blocked.
","path":"network-policy.yaml"}
